proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Direct and Indirect Lobbying Activities and Expenditures
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Lilly's direct and indirect lobbying, grassroots lobbying, payments to model-legislation organizations, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board, through its Public Policy and Compliance Committee, has reviewed this proposal and recommends a vote against it

proposals.title: Proposal to Publish a Report on the Effectiveness of the Forced Swim Test
proposals.proponent: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that Lilly assess the effectiveness of the Forced Swim Test in animal research and report findings to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Amend the Bylaws to Require an Independent Board Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adoption of a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the board chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal on Board Diversity Requesting Disclosures of Specific Minimum Qualifications and Board Nominee Skills, Experience, and Ideological Perspective
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of board nominee minimum qualifications and a skills, experience and ideological perspective matrix for each nominee.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Publish Feasibility Report on Incorporating Public Concern Over Drug Prices into Senior Executive Compensation Arrangements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing feasibility of incorporating public concern over high drug prices into senior executive compensation arrangements.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Implement a Bonus Deferral Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that senior executive bonuses based on one-year financial metrics be partly deferred and adjusted over a deferral period to reflect risk.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Clawbacks on Executive Incentive Compensation Due to Misconduct
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of whether incentive compensation was clawed back or forfeited from senior executives, including former ones, due to clawback provisions.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
